How to play

8 7 4 5 1 7

Three rules. That is all.

  1. 1Same number, or two that make 10.
  2. 2Joined by a straight path — across, down, or diagonal.
  3. 3Or the end of a row to the start of the next.

Either way, nothing may be left standing in between.

Tap two tiles showing the same number.

…or two tiles that add up to 10.

The two tiles must sit on a straight line — any of the 8 directions.

…or be neighbours in reading order — the end of a row wraps to the start of the next.

Empty a whole row and it collapses — everything above drops down.

Four buttons in battle

  1. Attack — fills with every point you score, and fires on its own when full.
  2. Special — fills only when you alternate sum-10 and same-number matches. One hit is worth two attacks.
  3. Awakening — every match charges it, faster the higher your combo. It turns the board your way for a few seconds.
  4. Partner — your chosen partner’s skill, a few uses each round.

A star fruit fills Awakening at once; a pet fruit gives one more Partner use.
